svg.text: numerics: 5x smaller AND far faster to loop in C

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
'Segoe UI', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: * millions of small objects is where memory goes, not the data itself (sys.getsizeof shows only the shallow size)

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: * __slots__ / dataclass(slots=True) drops the instance __dict__; array / NumPy drops the boxing entirely

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: * speed follows memory: fewer bytes per item means fewer cache misses and, for NumPy, loops executed in C
